$comment: Map of the codebase. Start here, then open the linked doc. Regenerate/keep in sync when changing a plugin.
repo: Z:/z_youtube_player (fork of th-ch/youtube-music a.k.a. pear-desktop; push to remote "fork", never "origin")

documents.covers: process model, boot, plugin system, config, IPC channel reference, providers, tray/menu, build, types
YouTube player-bar DOM (new ytmusic-miniplayer + old ytmusic-player-bar), dom-elements.ts helpers, how controls/feeds were ported, traps
build/install, safe build, CDP harnesses, diagnostics, git remotes
all fork changes on top of upstream with commits

userState.installedExe: Z:/z_youtube_player/pack/win-unpacked/YouTube Music.exe (taskbar pin + Start Menu point here)

core.name: Process model and boot sequence
core.summary: Main/preload/renderer split, numbered main and renderer boot timelines (main plugins before menu and tray, #movie_player wait, onPlayerApiReady, peard:audio-can-play), the 2026-10-01 player-bar fallback pattern and DOM events

core.name: Plugin system
core.summary: Glob discovery into virtual:plugins, pluginStub synthesis, createPlugin shape and lifecycle hooks, per-process ctx objects, loaders, runtime enable/disable via config.watch, i18n keys

core.name: Config
core.summary: electron-store at %APPDATA%\YouTube Music\config.json: every options.* key with default and reader, plugin config merge rule, migrations

core.name: IPC channel reference
core.summary: Every core IPC channel with direction, payload, sender and handler, plus song-controls API, song-info pipeline, setup-*-listener singletons and per-plugin internal channels

core.name: Providers
core.summary: One section per provider: app controls, decorators, new/legacy player-bar DOM helpers and app store, protocol handler, SongInfo build and events, English PREF cookie pin

core.name: Tray, menu and window utils
core.summary: Tray creation and queued click/double-click/mouse-move handlers, application menu and Options tree, virtual-desktop-aware show, custom features touching core

core.name: Build and packaging
core.summary: electron-vite three-build config, electron-builder targets with output to pack/, package.json scripts, purpose of each pnpm patch

core.name: Types
core.summary: One line per src/types file; GetState app-store shape and the MusicPlayer (#movie_player) API

custom.name: Limited Repeat
custom.summary: A-B loop: LR button after Repeat drops draggable [ ] markers on the seek bar; disposable (spent by other controls, song change, repeat change).

custom.name: Audio-Only Mode
custom.summary: Forces ATV_PREFERRED playback mode, tiny quality, hides video and shows album art to save ~300MB RAM.

custom.name: Playback Recovery
custom.summary: Watchdog (3s) detects dead/frozen/buffer-exhausted playback and escalates seek -> seek+1s -> next track; stands down while LR is active.

custom.name: Virtual Desktop Awareness
custom.summary: Option to show the window on the current virtual desktop (pin/unpin setVisibleOnAllWorkspaces); also deferred tray-handler queue.

custom.name: Tray Hover Mini-Player
custom.summary: Hover the tray icon for a floating card with art, title, artist and prev/play/next; part of the notifications plugin.
custom.newPlayerBarStatus: prev/next depended on old bar via renderer IPC - fixed 2026-10-01, verified

custom.name: Interface Language Pinned to English
custom.summary: Writes hl=en into the YouTube PREF cookie before load and re-asserts it on every PREF change.

plugins.name: Audio Compressor
plugins.summary: Inserts a DynamicsCompressorNode (threshold -50, ratio 12) between the shared MediaElementSource and the destination.

plugins.name: Crossfade [Beta]
plugins.summary: Fades the old song out over the new one using a muted, synced Howler copy of the stream (URL fetched via youtubei.js in the backend).
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: index.ts:278 clicks dead '.next-button', so the early transition (secondsBeforeEnd) never fires; navigation-triggered crossfades still run. Fix: getPlayerControl('Next')

plugins.name: Equalizer
plugins.summary: Adds BiquadFilter nodes (bass-booster preset plus custom config filters) in parallel to the shared audio graph.

plugins.name: Exponential Volume
plugins.summary: Patches HTMLMediaElement.prototype.volume to a cubic curve so low volumes are easier to select.

plugins.name: Precise Volume
plugins.summary: Step-based volume via wheel/arrow keys/global shortcuts with a HUD, persisting the volume across sessions.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: setupPlaybar returns early (renderer.ts:134, no ytmusic-player-bar) so bar wheel and the #volume-slider observer are gone; manual slider drags are not saved to savedVolume (stale value restored on next launch); slider sync/tooltips no-op. Arrow keys, global shortcuts, mpris, #main-panel wheel and HUD still work

plugins.name: Playback Speed
plugins.summary: Injects a 0.07x-16x speed slider into the player-bar song menu and enforces the rate on every track.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: likely broken: isPlayerMenu (plugins/utils/renderer/check.ts:55) requires 'ytmusic-menu-renderer.ytmusic-player-bar', so the speed slider is never injected into the song menu; speed stays 1

plugins.name: Video Quality Changer
plugins.summary: Adds a gear button to the video overlay that opens a native dialog to pick the playback quality.

plugins.name: Skip Silences
plugins.summary: AnalyserNode-based silence detection that seeks forward 0.2 s while silent (optionally only at track start).

plugins.name: Custom Output Device
plugins.summary: Routes the shared AudioContext to a chosen audio output via AudioContext.setSinkId.

plugins.name: Visualizer
plugins.summary: Butterchurn/Vudio/Wave audio visualizer drawn on a canvas inside #player.

plugins.name: Disable Autoplay
plugins.summary: Pauses each newly loaded track on 'dataloaded' (optionally only the first one after launch).

plugins.name: Album Color Theme
plugins.summary: Mixes the current thumbnail's average colour into YTM's dark-theme CSS variables; optional themed seek bar.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: enableSeekbar gradient targets dead '.seekbar-theme #progress-bar.ytmusic-player-bar' (style.css:89) and the player-bar colour fixes (.menu/.time-info/.volume-slider.ytmusic-player-bar, ytmusic-player-bar; style.css:51-65) are dead; the main CSS-variable theme is unaffected

plugins.name: Ambient Mode
plugins.summary: Blurred canvas/image glow of the current video or cover behind the player on the player page.

plugins.name: Blur Navigation Bar
plugins.summary: Translucent black, 8px-blurred nav bar and sticky tabs; hides the nav divider.

plugins.name: Compact Sidebar
plugins.summary: Clicks the guide hamburger so the left sidebar stays in compact (mini-guide) mode.

plugins.name: Clock
plugins.summary: Clock centred in the nav bar, optional seconds and 12/24h format.

plugins.name: Transparent Player
plugins.summary: Windows-only: Mica/Acrylic/Tabbed window material plus semi-transparent, blurred page backgrounds.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: '#layout ytmusic-player-bar { background: none }' (style.css:69) is dead, so the new ytmusic-miniplayer keeps its own background; #player-bar-background existence unverified; window material and other page rules unaffected

plugins.name: Unobtrusive Player
plugins.summary: Hides/auto-closes the player page when a song is started from a list or Shuffle play.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: likely broken: e.target.closest('ytmusic-player-bar') (index.ts:11) never matches, so clicking the bar no longer clears unobtrusive-player--did-play; the player page stays visibility:hidden and keeps auto-closing on track change; .toggle-player-page-button unverified

plugins.name: Picture-in-picture
plugins.summary: Native video PiP or a shrunk always-on-top window-PiP, via hotkey, song-menu entry, or minimize button.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: likely broken (partly): song-menu PiP entry never injected because isPlayerMenu (check.ts:54-56) requires 'ytmusic-menu-renderer.ytmusic-player-bar'; '.middle-controls' (renderer.tsx:67) and all ytmusic-player-bar PiP-mode CSS are dead; .fullscreen-button/#expanding-menu/.toggle-player-page-button unverified; hotkey + native PiP (default) unaffected

plugins.name: Video Toggle
plugins.summary: Custom Song/Video switch over the player (or native/disabled AV toggle), optional force-hide of the video panel.

plugins.name: In-App Menu
plugins.summary: Frameless window with a custom HTML title bar rendering the app menu (and window controls on Linux).
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: unaffected (caveat: titlebar.css:61 uses var(--ytmusic-player-bar-height) and :73 var(--ytmusic-player-page-player-bar-height), both unverified; if gone, the player-page height / mini-player transform calc() becomes invalid)

plugins.name: Navigation
plugins.summary: Back/forward arrow buttons (history.back/forward) prepended to the nav bar's right content.

plugins.name: API Server [Beta]
plugins.summary: Local HTTP(S) REST + WebSocket API (Hono, JWT auth with first-use approval dialog) to control and observe the player, with OpenAPI/Swagger docs.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: GET /api/v1/like-state reads document.querySelector('#like-button-renderer')?.likeStatus via executeJavaScript (backend/main.ts:134-136) and now always returns {state:null}; all other endpoints and WebSocket messages go through the fixed IPC paths

plugins.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugins.summary: Shows the current song as a Discord 'Listening' activity over local Discord RPC (@xhayper/discord-rpc), with throttling, auto-reconnect and pause timeout.

plugins.name: Scrobbler
plugins.summary: Sends now-playing and scrobbles (at min(half duration, 4 min)) to Last.fm (signed API + browser auth window) and/or ListenBrainz (user token).

plugins.name: Lumia Stream [Beta]
plugins.summary: POSTs song state on every song-info event to the local Lumia Stream app at http://127.0.0.1:39231/api/media with a hardcoded token.

plugins.name: Tuna OBS
plugins.summary: POSTs song state to the OBS Tuna plugin web server at http://127.0.0.1:1608/, falling back to OPTIONS probes (lite mode) while it is unreachable.

plugins.name: Music Together [Beta]
plugins.summary: Peer-to-peer (PeerJS/WebRTC) shared listening: host/guest sessions that sync the queue via #queue store dispatch injection and push playback progress, with host-controlled permissions.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: guest seek broadcast (permission 'all') patches _update on tp-yt-paper-progress (old #progress-bar internals, index.ts:596-626); the new bar uses input.ytMusicMiniPlayerProgressBar, so guest-initiated seeks likely stop syncing silently. Host->guest progress/state/index sync, queue sync (#queue store, ytmusic-app.networkManager) and guest play/pause (onStateChange) are unaffected

plugins.name: Amuse
plugins.summary: Serves current song info as JSON on port 9863 (/query and /api) for the Amuse now-playing widget by 6K Labs.

plugins.name: Auth Proxy Adapter
plugins.summary: Local no-auth SOCKS5 server (default 127.0.0.1:4545) that relays CONNECTs through the authenticated upstream proxy in options.proxy; src/index.ts points Chromium's --proxy-server at it.

plugins.name: Downloader
plugins.summary: Downloads the current/selected song or a whole playlist via youtubei.js + ffmpeg.wasm (mp3 256k / source / custom preset, ID3 + cover), with optional auto-download after listening.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: whether the new bar's MORE button opens the ytmusic-menu-popup-renderer popup the Download entry is injected into is unverified (song-row menus elsewhere unaffected); download-on-finish needs peard:time-changed, which at HEAD only came from the dead #progress-bar, so it effectively never fires except seconds mode on tracks shorter than the threshold (the uncommitted working-tree song-info-front.ts adds a <video> timeupdate fallback)

plugins.name: Synced Lyrics
plugins.summary: Takes over the Lyrics tab with time-synced or plain lyrics from YTMusic, LRCLib, MusixMatch and LyricsGenius (provider picker, star per video, romanization, line effects).

plugins.name: Captions Selector
plugins.summary: Player-bar button that opens a prompt to choose a caption track; optionally autoloads the last language or disables captions.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: likely broken: the button mounts into .right-controls-buttons (old ytmusic-player-bar #right-controls), which is gone, so onPlayerApiReady fails before reading the tracklist or attaching the peard:src-changed listener; no button, and autoload/disableCaptions are dead too

plugins.name: SponsorBlock
plugins.summary: Fetches SponsorBlock segments per video in main and seeks the <video> past them on timeupdate.

plugins.name: Skip Disliked Songs
plugins.summary: Clicks Next when the current song's like-status becomes DISLIKE.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: likely broken: #like-button-renderer and yt-icon-button.next-button are both gone; waitForElement (maxRetry -1) polls every 100 ms forever and the dislike observer is never attached

plugins.name: Album Actions
plugins.summary: Adds Undislike/Dislike/Like/Unlike-all buttons to album/playlist headers that click every track row's like/dislike button.

plugins.name: Performance improvement [Beta]
plugins.summary: Injects CY Fung's rm3 (Polymer element recycling) and CPU tamer (setTimeout/setInterval coalescing) userscripts into the renderer.

plugins.name: Shortcuts
plugins.summary: Global (globalShortcut) and window-local (electron-localshortcut) hotkeys for previous/play-pause/next, optional hardware media-key override, and an MPRIS D-Bus player on Linux.

plugins.name: TouchBar
plugins.summary: macOS Touch Bar with cover + title scrubber and previous/play-pause/next/dislike/like segmented buttons.

plugins.name: Taskbar Media Control
plugins.summary: Windows taskbar thumbnail toolbar (setThumbarButtons) with previous/play-pause/next, theme-aware icons, re-applied on song change and window show.

plugins.name: Notifications
plugins.summary: Song-change desktop notifications (Linux urgency), Windows interactive toast XML with prev/play-pause/next protocol buttons in 7 styles and tray-click toggle; fork adds a tray hover mini-player.

plugins.name: Plugin utilities
plugins.summary: Shared helpers (not a plugin): injectCSS, injectCSSAsFile, fileExists, getNetFetchAsFetch, defineMainPlugin/definePreloadPlugin/defineMenuPlugin, definePluginConfig + legacy plugin types, ElementFromHtml, ImageElementFromSrc, isMusicOrVideoTrack, isAlbumOrPlaylist, isPlayerMenu.
plugins.newPlayerBarStatus: partially affected: isPlayerMenu matches dead selector ytmusic-menu-renderer.ytmusic-player-bar, so it always returns falsy and picture-in-picture / playback-speed never inject into the player song menu; other helpers unaffected
